caption:
Most missed trips from Dubai are not refusals. They are timing.

Appointment availability at UAE consulates tightens sharply before peak season. Once the slots are gone, no amount of preparation gets them back.

Work backwards from your travel date: appointment wait, processing time, and a buffer for anything that needs correcting. Then start before that.

items: Subtract the appointment wait for your consulate

slides.headline: THE EARLY FILE IS THE SAME FILE.
slides.sub: It just has room to go wrong safely.

slides.headline: THE SHORTCUT THAT ISN'T
slides.never: Pay someone who promises a guaranteed appointment for cash. Nobody holds a private reserve, and you will have no recourse when it does not appear.
slides.instead: Keep a complete file submission-ready, monitor availability daily, and move the moment a slot opens. That is the whole method.
